The mechanism appears to involve a chain of interactions, where Benzamide may modulate the activity of the intermediates, potentially through direct or indirect mechanisms. The evidence supports a possible regulatory role of Benzamide in the function of the transporter, though the exact nature of the interaction remains unclear.
